description: Hi! I’m Samyog, a robotics and technology enthusiast passionate about space exploration, engineering, and innovation. Our team is interested in solving challenges related to lunar landing and site navigation. I have hands-on experience with robotics, Arduino, drones, sensors, and building practical, AI/ML, data analysis, simulation, mapping, and problem-solving. Whether you’re experienced or eager to learn, we’d love to collaborate, share ideas, and build something innovative together!
